WITH 
  pedidos_validos AS (
    SELECT * FROM vw_pedidos_validos
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  ),
  retrasos AS (
    SELECT 
      pv.order_id, 
      AVG(rv.review_score) AS calificacion, 
      julianday(pv.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(pv.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso
    FROM pedidos_validos pv
    JOIN order_reviews rv ON pv.order_id = rv.order_id
    GROUP BY pv.order_id
  ),
  rangos_retraso AS (
    SELECT 
      CASE 
        WHEN dias_retraso <= 0 THEN 'a_tiempo'
        WHEN dias_retraso <= 3 THEN '1-3'
        WHEN dias_retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7'
        ELSE '8-14'
      END AS rango_retraso, 
      COUNT(*) AS pedidos, 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN calificacion <= 2 THEN 1 END) AS pedidos_2_o_menos
    FROM retrasos
    GROUP BY rango_retraso
  )
SELECT 
  rango_retraso, 
  pedidos, 
  pedidos_2_o_menos / pedidos * 100 AS pct_2_o_menos, 
  (SELECT pedidos_2_o_menos / pedidos * 100 FROM rangos_retraso WHERE rango_retraso = 'a_tiempo') AS pct_2_o_menos_a_tiempo
FROM rangos_retraso
WHERE pedidos_2_o_menos

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS vendedores,
  SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_total
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.price IS NOT NULL THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rv.review_score IS NOT NULL THEN rv.review_score ELSE NULL END) AS calificacion,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vw_entregas_retrasos WHERE dias_retraso > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entregas_tardias,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS pedidos
  FROM 
    sellers s
  JOIN 
    order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE 
    oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vw_pedidos_validos)
  GROUP BY 
    s.seller_id
  HAVING 
    pedidos >= 30
) AS subconsulta
WHERE 
  calificacion < 3.5 OR entregas_tardias * 100 / pedidos > 15
ORDER BY 
  ingresos DESC
LIMIT 0.25 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers)

  op2.payment_installments > 1
